candidates.title: Living Hope

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: How great the chasm that lay between us How high the
Mountain I could not climb
In desperation I turned to heaven And spoke your name into the night
Then through the darkness,
Your loving kindness
Tore through the shadows of my soul
The work is finished,
The end is written Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: Christ, my living hope
Who could imagine so great a mercy
What heart could fathom such boundless grace The
God of ages stepped down from glory
To wear my sin and bear my shame
The cross has spoken,
I am forgiven, the King of kings has calling me hands on
Beautiful Savior, I'm yours forever

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Christ, my living hope
Hallelujah, praise the one who set me free
Hallelujah, death has lost its grip on me You
Have broken every chain
There's salvation in your name Jesus
Christ, my living hope

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Then came the morning that sealed the promise
Your buried body began to breathe
And out of the silence the roaring lion
Declared the grave has no claim on me That's good news!
Sing that again!
Then came the morning that sealed the promise
The very body began to break
And out of the silence The rolling lion

lyrics.label: Verse 5
lines: Declared that the grave,
Cast no blame on me
Jesus, your love is my victory. Oh, hallelujah
Praise the one who set me free
Hallelujah, dead I'm lost,
It's great for me
You have broken every chain,
There's salvation in your name Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 6
lines: Christ, my living hope
Hallelujah, praise the one who set me free Hallelujah

lyrics.label: Verse 7
lines: Today I've lost this grip on me You
Have broken every chain
There's salvation in your name Jesus
Christ, my living hope
Christ, my living hope

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: You're my living hope Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 8
lines: There's nothing we have to do
No, there's nothing I have to be for you, Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 9
lines: You're everything, Jesus
You're high as the sun
You're the King of kings. Oh,
You're just a victory
Every time, you're the reason we sing

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: Thank you, Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 10
lines: Praise the one who set me free Hallelujah Hallelujah
Death has lost its grip on me
You have broken every chain
There shall be joy in your name Jesus
Christ, my living hope
Christ, my living hope
